verdict.rationale: Weave documents alerts that route to Slack and trigger webhook automations, and describes coding agents (via MCP/skills) connecting to Weave to 'execute automatic iteration loops on their own' — both evidence of some background/autonomous automation. However there is no documentation of a scheduling engine, cron-like triggers, or a dedicated automation builder within Weave itself; the closest capability is reactive alert-to-webhook wiring and external agent-driven iteration loops. Missing for 10: native scheduled/triggered automation workflows inside Weave, independent evidence of these automations running unattended in production, and detail on configuring autonomous loops beyond MCP-connected coding agents.
